user.title: Connect to Yeedi
user.description: Enter your Yeedi account email, password, and the 2-letter country code registered with your account.

verify.title: Verify your Yeedi device
verify.description: Yeedi sent a verification code to {email}. Enter it below to complete device verification. (The code is one-time use and tied to this device; if you cancel and retry, the same code cannot be reused.)

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to the Yeedi cloud. Check your email, password, and country code.
error.invalid_verification_code: The verification code is incorrect or expired. Try again, or restart setup to receive a new code.
error.verification_code_required: Enter the 6-digit code from the email Yeedi just sent.
